description: Redefine the WorkflowRunStatus state machine so each value denotes exactly one scheduling waiting object (Created/Pending/Ready/Running/.../terminal), persist status as a STORED computed column, collapse the two runner scheduling queries to pure DB-layer filters, reclassify historical data, and surface pending vs ready distinctly in the Web UI.

tasks.title: Redefine WorkflowRunStatus state machine and audit every status write site
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-run-lifecycle/spec.md#WorkflowRunStatus enumeration captures a single waiting object per status
tasks.description: Redefine the WorkflowRunStatus enum to Created, Pending, Ready, Running, AwaitingApproval, Paused, Stopped, Completed, Failed with the single-waiting-object semantics (D1). Audit and correct all ~19 run.Status = write sites plus the Advance() default so every transition lands on the new machine: Create→Created, Start→Pending (admit Created/Paused), AssignRunner→Ready, StartTask→Running, CompleteTask-with-remaining→Ready/Pending, Pause/Resume/Approve/Fail/Stop correct (D2). Add a consolidated domain IsTerminal() shared by domain/grain/querier, and an activation-time reconciliation shim that corrects a persisted Ready row that actually has in-flight work back to Running on load.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowRunStatus contains exactly Created, Pending, Ready, Running, AwaitingApproval, Paused, Stopped, Completed, Failed in that order, with no other value

Start moves Created→Pending and never directly to Running/Ready; AssignRunner moves Pending→Ready; StartTask moves Ready→Running; CompleteTask with remaining dispatchable work returns to Ready (Ready if assigned, Pending if unassigned); Advance with no pending work completes/advances stage
Pause admits any executing state→Paused; Resume lands on Running when in-flight work exists else Ready; Approve moves AwaitingApproval→Ready; Fail/Stop/Reject land on their terminal targets unchanged
Every run.Status = assignment site across the WorkflowRun partial files and WorkflowGrain is reviewed against the audit table; no off-machine write remains
A single domain IsTerminal() helper is introduced and the grain's duplicated IsTerminal check delegates to it
The activation-time shim corrects a loaded Ready status to Running when in-flight work is detected
New domain unit tests cover each transition point (Start, AssignRunner, StartTask, CompleteTask-with-remaining, CompleteTask-no-remaining, Pause, Resume both branches, Approve, Fail, Stop) and pass
Existing workflow-related server tests are updated to the new vocabulary and pass
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Workflow/Domain/Run/ (WorkflowRun.cs enum + partial-file write sites + IsTerminal helper + activation shim) with updated/new domain unit tests under Specs/Workflow/Domain/
tasks.notes: This is the foundation: every other task depends on the new enum and transition semantics. Per D2 do NOT introduce a central CanTransition matrix or privatize the setter — that is an explicit non-goal, follow the scattered-guard audit approach instead.

tasks.title: Persist status as a STORED computed column and collapse scheduling queries to DB-layer filters
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-run-lifecycle/spec.md#Runner scheduling queries filter by status at the database layer
tasks.description: Add the STORED status computed column (LOWER(COALESCE(json_extract(State,'$.status'), json_extract(State,'$.Status')))) plus IX_WorkflowRuns_Status to the WorkflowRuns model in MohistDbContext (D3). Rewrite FindAssignableAsync to Where(status == Pending) and FindAssignedToAsync to Where(status == Ready && AssignedRunnerId == runner), dropping the in-memory State-deserialize and NextWork() re-filter loops (D4). Rewrite ActiveWorkflowCountAsync (which currently reuses FindAssignedToAsync + GetCurrentWorkIdAsync and would collapse to 0 once Ready excludes in-flight) to count status == Running rows via a new count query. Drop the GetCurrentWorkIdAsync busy pre-check in RunnerGrain.PollAssignedOrAssignableWorkflowAsync so every Ready row surfaced is polled directly via PollWorkAsync.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowRuns has a STORED status computed column with the LOWER(COALESCE(...)) definition and an IX_WorkflowRuns_Status index in the DbContext model
FindAssignableAsync filters at the DB layer on status = Pending and returns no Created/Ready/Running/AwaitingApproval/Paused/Stopped/Completed/Failed rows
FindAssignedToAsync filters at the DB layer on status = Ready AND AssignedRunnerId = runner and returns no Running, terminal, or other-runner Ready rows
Neither scheduling query deserializes non-matching State rows into the application process or applies an in-memory status/assignment re-filter loop
ActiveWorkflowCountAsync counts status = Running rows for the runner (returns a correct non-zero count, not 0)
RunnerGrain.PollAssignedOrAssignableWorkflowAsync calls PollWorkAsync directly on each FindAssignedToAsync row and no longer calls GetCurrentWorkIdAsync as a busy pre-check
New/existing query and runner-grain specs assert the filtered results and the direct-pickup behavior, and pass
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Infrastructure/Data/ (DbContext computed-column + WorkflowRunQuerier query rewrites + ActiveWorkflowCountAsync count query) and packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Runner/Grains/RunnerGrain.cs poll-loop simplification, with query/runner specs
tasks.notes: ActiveWorkflowCountAsync regression is required for correctness even though the issue text does not name it (see design D4). The actual EF migration that materializes the STORED column at deploy time is produced in T-004; this task only updates the code model and queries.

tasks.title: Extend runner-side cleanup guard vocabulary to the new status enum
tasks.description: Extend packages/runner/src/runtime/workflow-terminal-status.ts so the WorkflowRunStatusName union includes Created and Ready (the new non-terminal values), matching the server enum contract. TERMINAL_WORKFLOW_STATUSES stays exactly the three terminal values, so by construction created/pending/ready/running/paused/awaitingApproval all continue to block automatic workspace removal. No behavioral change to the cleanup safety logic is needed — only the type contract is widened (D7).
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowRunStatusName union type includes 'created' and 'ready' in addition to the existing values
TERMINAL_WORKFLOW_STATUSES remains exactly the stopped/completed/failed set
Runner cleanup-guard unit tests assert that a workspace owned by a workflow run in created, pending, or ready state is never removed by automatic cleanup
Existing runner cleanup-guard tests still pass
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/runtime/workflow-terminal-status.ts (union extension) with updated/new cleanup-guard unit tests
tasks.notes: The cleanup safety logic is already correct-by-construction (everything not in the terminal set blocks removal), so this is a type-contract widening only — no behavioral code change beyond the union.

tasks.title: Add EF migration: STORED status column and historical reclassification
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-run-lifecycle/spec.md#Historical workflow runs are reclassified to their true new status
tasks.description: Produce a new EF migration (yyyyMMddHHmmss_WorkflowRunStatus.cs) that does two things. (a) Schema: add the STORED status computed column + IX_WorkflowRuns_Status using the established two-step SQLite pattern (AddColumn nullable plain column, then AlterColumn to the STORED computed definition so EF emits the table rebuild). (b) Data: conditional json_set reclassification of persisted State per the four scenarios — old 'pending'→'created'; old 'running' with no assignment→'pending'; old 'running' with assignment and in-flight work (a json_each over $.stages finding a task status 'running' or non-null checksWorkId) stays 'running'; old 'running' with assignment and no in-flight work→'ready'. Terminal/paused/awaitingApproval rows are untouched. Provide a schema Down (drop column + index) but no reclassification Down — the change is forward-only.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration adds the STORED status computed column and IX_WorkflowRuns_Status, materializing at deploy time via the SQLite two-step table-rebuild pattern
A persisted old-'pending' row is reclassified to 'created'
A persisted old-'running' row with no runner assignment is reclassified to 'pending'
A persisted old-'running' row with an assignment and in-flight work is kept as 'running'
A persisted old-'running' row with an assignment and no in-flight work is reclassified to 'ready'
Persisted terminal/paused/awaitingApproval rows are unchanged by the migration
Schema Down drops the status column and index; no data Down is provided (forward-only)

A new WorkflowRunStatusReclassificationMigrationSpecs seeds each old-shape row and asserts the reclassified value, and a schema spec asserts the STORED column + index; both pass following the BackfillIssueCompletedAtMigrationSpecs precedent
tasks.notes: Validate the exact $.stages[*].tasks[*].status / checksWorkId json_each paths against a real persisted State sample during implementation (Open Question D5). The activation-time shim from T-001 is the runtime backstop for any imperfect SQL in-flight detection.

tasks.title: Surface pending vs ready distinctly in the Web UI status surface
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-run-lifecycle/spec.md#Web UI distinguishes pending-claim from assigned-waiting
tasks.description: Extend WorkflowStatusMapper.FrontendStatus to emit created/ready for the new enum values (keeping awaiting-approval/paused mappings) and fix the BuildPendingWork guard (currently Status != Running → null) to show pending work for both Ready and Running (D6). On the web, render WorkflowTimeline.status (pending/ready/running) as three distinct presentations where run-level status is shown so capacity-shortage (Pending) vs stuck-runner (Ready) are diagnosable separately. Remove or update the stale, unused WorkflowRunStatus model type in packages/web/src/entities/issue/model/workflow-run.ts to avoid future confusion.
acceptanceCriteria: FrontendStatus emits 'created' and 'ready' for the new WorkflowRunStatus values while preserving existing awaiting-approval/paused mappings
BuildPendingWork returns pending work for Ready and Running runs (not only Running)
The Web UI renders WorkflowTimeline.status pending, ready, and running as visually distinct presentations (a Pending run is distinguishable from a Ready run and from a Running run)
The stale WorkflowRunStatus model type in workflow-run.ts is removed or corrected to match the server contract
Web typecheck and web tests pass
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/.../WorkflowStatusMapper.cs (FrontendStatus + BuildPendingWork) and packages/web/src/ status render surfaces + workflow-run.ts model cleanup, with web tests
tasks.notes: Status reaches the web as a lowercase string via WorkflowStatusMapper.BuildStatusView → WorkflowTimeline.status on GET /issues/{n}/workflow/status; do not build on the disconnected WorkflowRun fetch path (it is never fetched by a hook today). The precise render component is an implementation-time decision against the existing HealthPill/stage-bar layout (Open Question D6).
